content: Transaction list UX: filters (category, type, date range/month picker) combine with AND logic, shown as removable chips plus a single Clear/Reset action; sort by date or amount (newest/highest first as default); search composes with filters; filter+page state kept in URL query string, not local state; pagination preferred over infinite scroll for finance data so totals stay predictable; mobile collapses to single column, desktop shows filters alongside the list.
